title: HomeGuardian network observation message
description: One framed JSON message a device sends to the hub. Framing is a 4-byte big-endian length prefix; the whole payload is capped at 4096 bytes. Scalars only: no frame, no audio samples and no free-form text.

device_id.description: A CLAIM. The hub re-derives identity from the client certificate.

observation_id.description: Unique per observation; a repeat is refused as a replay.

source_type.description: Hub policy vocabulary; an unknown value is refused.

observation_type.description: Hub policy vocabulary; an unknown value is refused.

acquired_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, from a synchronised clock.

features.description: Bounded scalars. A blob here cannot be framed.

provenance_claim.description: A CLAIM. The hub records what it can substantiate.

resume_after_sequence.description: welcome only: the highest sequence the hub already accepted.

detail.description: ack/error only: a bounded, non-sensitive explanation.
